summary: Revised implementation plan incorporating all four architectural refinements: (A) Single active module viewport with internal master-detail split panes only where productive; (B) Context-aware Floating Command Bar that adapts actions and filters to the active module while retaining global search (Cmd+K); (C) Dedicated Mobile layout architecture (5-tab Bottom Navigation + More module hub, compact command bar, bottom-sheet quick actions, and full-screen forms) separate from the desktop 2-level sidebar; and (D) Shared Carbon-inspired design token system mapped cleanly to native/Tailwind components without external UI library lock-in.
